identificationModule.briefTitle: Pirtobrutinib Combined With BEAM for ASCT in Relapsed and Refractory DLBCL
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Multicenter, Single-Arm Clinical Study of Pirtobrutinib Combined With Carmustine, Etoposide, Cytarabine, and Melphalan (BEAM) as a Preconditioning Regimen for ASCT in Relapsed and Refractory DLBCL

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This trial is a prospective, multi-center, single-arm clinical research. The intention is to evaluate the efficacy and safety of pirtobrutinib combined with BEAM as a pretreatment regimen for ASCT in relapsed and refractory DLBCL patients.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: A total of 28 patients with relapsed/refractory DLBCL are planned to be enrolled in this trial. They will receive pirtobrutinib in combination with the BEAM regimen as conditioning therapy, followed by ASCT. The study comprises a screening period, a treatment period (days -8 to -2, 7 days in total), and a 2-year follow-up period after transplantation.

armGroups.label: pirtobrutinib combined with camustine, etoposide, cytarabine, and mafaran (BEAM)

interventions.name: pirtobrutinib combined with BEAM
interventions.description: pirtobrutinib 200mg oral qd D-8-D-2; camustine: 300mg/m2 vgtt qd D-8; etoposide: 100mg/m2/d vgtt q12h D-7-D-4; cytarabine: 200mg/m2/d vgtt q12h D-7-D-4 melphalan: 70mg/m2 vgtt qd D3-D-2.
armGroupLabels: pirtobrutinib combined with camustine, etoposide, cytarabine, and mafaran (BEAM)

primaryOutcomes.description: Progression-free survival was defined as the time from the data of ASCT until the date of the first documented day of disease progression or relapse, using Lugano criteria, or death from an cause, whichever occured first.
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Baseline up to data cut-off (up to approxiamately 2 years)

secondaryOutcomes.description: Overall survival was defined as the time from the date of ASCT to the date of death from any cause
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Baseline up to data cut-off (up to approxiamately 2 years)

secondaryOutcomes.description: Percentage of participants with complete response was determined on 2014 Lugano criteria

The first day of neutrophils ≥0.5\*109/L for 3 consecutive days was the time of successful implantation of granulocytes. Platelet ≥20.0\*109/L for 7 consecutive days and the first day after platelet infusion was considered as the successful time of megakaryocytes implantation
Transplantation-related adverse reactions are any untoward medical occurrence in a participant which is related to ASCT.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Baseline up to data cut-off (up to approxiamately 4 years)
